name: Psychometric Reading
summary: After Psychometric Reading, Quintis Jonespyre is still unsteady. His vision shows Raschal and the Woodpaw gnolls, and Quintis asks you to carry word to Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

sections.title: What Quintis Saw
sections.body: Quintis Jonespyre is unsteady, but his vision may help. Raschal pulls two large leather backpacks from the boat, heads inland, then returns to the boat. Gnoll scalps appear, and Quintis believes Raschal met Woodpaw gnolls. Raschal is very worried, almost terrified, and does not notice water elementals forming behind him. Then the images end. Quintis needs rest, so he asks you to tell Ginro, who needs to know.

sections.title: Ginro's Answer
sections.body: Ginro Hearthkindle thanks you for bringing Quintis's visions. Raschal can handle a fight, and gnolls would not worry him, let alone terrify him. Even so, Ginro hopes you and your companions can act on this and make the breakthrough they badly need.

faq.q: Who has the vision to share?
faq.answer: Quintis Jonespyre has the vision to share. Still wobbly after reading the knife, he asks you to carry word of it to Ginro.

faq.q: What did Quintis see in his vision?
faq.answer: Raschal took two large leather backpacks from the boat inland, then returned to it. Quintis saw gnoll scalps and believed the gnolls were Woodpaw. He also saw Raschal very worried, almost terrified, while water elementals formed behind him.

faq.q: Where does this report need to go?
aliases: where do i deliver the vision
who do i talk to psychometric reading
faq.answer: Take the report to Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.
